system.notes:
Normal | Skulk

A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.
Motives & Tactics: Defend territory, protect pack, surround, trail

Difficulty: 12 | Thresholds: 5/9 | HP: 4 | Stress: 3

ATK: +2 | Bite & Claws: Melee | 1d6+2 physical

Experience: Keen Senses +3

Features

Pack Tactics - Passive: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another ally is within Melee range of the target, their damage becomes 1d6+5 physical and you gain a Fear.

Hobbling Strike - Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.
